items.title: Kollam Mohan, veteran Malayalam film still photographer, dies after falling from moving train in Tamil Nadu
items.sum: Renowned Malayalam film still photographer Kollam Mohan died at age 73 after falling from a moving train near Kuzhithurai West railway station in Tamil Nadu on 12 November. He was travelling from Thiruvananthapuram to Marthandam with his family to attend a family function when relatives discovered he was missing. Railway Police recovered his body and shifted it to Nagercoil Medical College Hospital for post-mortem. Mohan was well known for his work on sets since the 1980s and contributed to acclaimed films including Adoor Gopalakrishnan's Mathilukal.
